name: pm
description: Project-management scaffold + session skills. /pm:pm-scaffold stands up a client engagement, personal project, or in-place _pm/ from the datacraft starter; whats-next, checkpoint, and stepping-away run the day (morning open · mid-session re-aim · close); dashboard renders _pm/dashboard.html — a self-contained visual status page (Intent, wayfinder frontier, tasks) the rituals refresh automatically (0.7.0); discovery riffs a piece of work into a committed docs/intent/<slug>.md with a size call — the stage before /wayfinder or plan mode (0.8.0, replaces brainstorm-lite); WORKFLOW.md documents the stage chain and the docs/-vs-_pm/ rule; verify-before-done gates completion claims on fresh evidence; the _pm/context-map.md layer maps available sources with authority + freshness; okf holds the knowledge-bundle conventions. Delivery skills (design-handoff, html-artifacts) moved to the design-dc plugin in 0.5.0.
